description: The Office of Congressman Kweisi Mfume (MD-07) is currently accepting applications for Summer 2022 in our Baltimore and DC offices. description: The Democratic Staff of the House Committee on Natural Resources is currently seeking a full-time intern for Summer 2022 (May - August). Interns will conduct legislative research, prepare for hearings, assist with administrative duties, perform outreach, and aide communications. The position comes with a monthly stipend of $1,800 plus transit benefits. Our office currently operates on a hybrid basis - M, F remote and Tu, W, Th in-person. Depending on guidance from the CDC and Office of the Attending Physician, internship format may be modified to remote work at any time. Applicants will be considered on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we will only be reaching out to candidates who are being actively considered for this position. No phone calls, emails, or drop-ins please. This posting will be removed from the Committee's website when the position has been filled. Women, LGBTQ+, and minority candidates are encouraged to apply. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, disability, or age.
qualifications: Passionate about issues within the Natural Resources Committee's jurisdiction
Eager to learn about the committee process
how_to_apply: Address application materials to Anna Martin at NRD.Internships@mail.house.gov with the subject line "Spring Internship Application - First Name Last Name" by COB April 15, 2022. Include a (1) cover letter, (2) resume, (3) short writing sample, and (4) dates of availability.
equal_opportunity: All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, disability, or age.

description: Congressman Gregory W. Meeks (NY-5) is seeking an enthusiastic, highly motivated legislative and press/digital intern to work in-person in our Washington DC office for Summer 2022. description: Congressman Conor Lamb (PA-17) has openings for full and part-time congressional interns for his Washington, D.C. office during the Summer of 2022. Candidates should be motivated, flexible, and detail-oriented individuals with availability beginning in May, and a preference for those who can stay at least three months. description: The Democratic staff of the House Committee on Oversight and Reform, Subcommittee on Government Operations, is seeking an energetic and self-motivated graduate or law school student for a full-time internship for Summer 2022. The position offers the opportunity to gain substantive experience on an exciting and fast-paced Subcommittee, while participating directly in the oversight process and learning about the day-to-day operations of the House of Representatives. The Committee on Oversight and Reform is the primary investigative committee of the U.S. House of Representatives, with jurisdiction to investigate any matter at any time. The Subcommittee on Government Operations has jurisdiction over issues related to the federal civil service, whistleblower protections, the U.S. Postal Service; government management and accounting measures; the economy, efficiency, and management of government operations and activities; government reorganization; intergovernmental affairs, including state and local governments; federal information technology security, acquisition policy, and management; and federal property.
responsibilities: Assisting staff in preparing for congressional hearings
Attending various briefings and meetings with Executive Branch and private sector officials
Working closely with Committee counsel and staff
qualifications: Excellent written and oral communication skills
Willing to be in the office full time
how_to_apply: Interested applicants should apply by emailing their resume and cover letter in one PDF titled "last name, first name, Spring 2022 GovOps" to GovOpsSubcommittee@gmail.com with "Spring 2022 Internship Application" in the subject line. No phone calls or drop-ins please. Only applicants who are selected for an interview will receive a response.
